title: A changed requirement is planned against existing contracts and then completed

origin.reference: Cosmos workflow contract: preserve existing intent, plan consequential changes, continue an implementation request without a second command

task.prompt: Change refunds so a customer can partially refund one line item.
task.fixture: isolated repo with Cosmos skills and an existing completed refund feature

requirements.criterion: Inspect the existing contract and route consequential planning through /spec before production edits; after decisions and readiness are settled, continue implementation within the original task. Do not require another /tdd command.
The planner locates the existing feature and classifies additive versus superseding intent before proposing writes.

graders.procedure: Inspect the trace for existing PRD/issues and additive/supersede classification before affected writes. Verify required planning/readiness precede implementation; fail an unnecessary confirmation or a plan-only ending when no dependency blocks the requested change. Explicit planning-only requests must still stop at their plan.
